{{Top|fprot}}
Place this template at the end of unsourced sections or statements in articles if you cannot find a relevant source yourself, so long as the section or statement in question is not explicitly false, fanon, or otherwise unwelcome on the page.

Do not use this tag to label statements that you suspect to be false. Instead, insert the {{Tl|Disputed}} template at the top of the article or section and bring the issue up on the talk page. ([[WP:ATT]])
